name: Light Digest Whey Protein
ingredients_raw: Whey Blend (Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate, Whey Protein Hydrolysate), Alkalized Cocoa Powder, Fructooligosaccharides, Nature Identical Chocolate Flavor, Sodium Chloride, Thickener (INS 415), Dipotassium Hydrogen Phosphate, Thickeners (INS 466 & INS 407), Anti-Caking Agent (INS 551), Sweeteners (INS 955 & INS 950), Astaxanthin, Coenzyme Q10, Digestive Enzymes (Protease, Hemicellulase, Cellulase, Lipase, Papain, Fungal Diastase), & D-Biotin. Allergen Information: Contains milk. May contain Soy and nuts.
